The\\n    returned records are atomic: if any row fails, no records are returned.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    errors = []\\n    records = []\\n    seen_ids = set()\\n    base_unit = row_is_mapping = isinstance(row, dict)\\n        row_id = row.get(\\\"id\\\") if row_is_mapping else None\\n\\n        if not isinstance(row_id, str) or not row_id:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"id\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        duplicate = unique and row_id in seen_ids\\n        seen_ids.add(row_id)\\n\\n        amount = row.get(\\\"amount\\\")\\n        if (\\n            isinstance(amount, bool)\\n            or not isinstance(amount, (int, float))\\n            or not math.isfinite(amount)\\n            or amount < 0\\n        ):\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"amount\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        unit = row.get(\\\"unit\\\", base_unit)\\n        if unit not in units:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"unit\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        if duplicate:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"duplicate\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        records.append({\\n            \\\"id\\\": row_id,\\n            \\\"amount\\\": amount * units[unit],\\n            \\\"unit\\\": base_unit,\\n
